name: damage specific DNA binding protein 1

function.text: DDB1 encodes DNA damage-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and ubiquitin ligase complex scaffold activity. It participates in DNA repair and spermatogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to White-Kernohan syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
